title: Kingshot Items Database
intro: Verified uses, acquisition routes, and related systems for high-value Kingshot progression items.

truegold.title: Truegold
truegold.summary: Truegold is a late-game resource used for Truegold building stages and as an exchange input in the War Academy.
truegold.purpose: Upgrade eligible buildings and support late-game War Academy progression.
truegold.acquisition: Earned through eligible events, shops, packs, and other game systems unlocked with kingdom progression.

truegold-dust.title: Truegold Dust
truegold-dust.summary: Truegold Dust is the research material consumed by basic and advanced War Academy technologies.
truegold-dust.purpose: Fund War Academy research, including the paths that unlock T11 troops.
truegold-dust.acquisition: Obtained through eligible rewards and by using the War Academy exchange.

mythic-general-hero-shard.title: Mythic General Hero Shard
mythic-general-hero-shard.summary: A flexible shard used to increase the star level of an eligible Mythic hero that the player already owns.
mythic-general-hero-shard.purpose: Advance an eligible owned Mythic hero without requiring that hero's named shard.
mythic-general-hero-shard.acquisition: Available from selected events, milestone rewards, shops, and recurring progression systems.

forgehammers.title: Forgehammers
forgehammers.summary: Forgehammers are consumed by Mastery Forging for Mythic and Red Hero Gear.
forgehammers.purpose: Increase Hero Gear Mastery Forging levels after the required gear conditions are met.
forgehammers.acquisition: Available from selected events, shops, reward chests, and progression milestones.

transfer-passes.title: Transfer Passes
transfer-passes.summary: Transfer Passes are consumable items required to move an eligible character to another kingdom.
transfer-passes.purpose: Pay the pass requirement calculated by the game for a Kingdom Transfer.
transfer-passes.acquisition: Available through the Alliance Shop and eligible paid packs; the required amount depends on the live transfer score.
